findings.message: stdout of this child is never read before its close is awaited, so output past the pipe buffer blocks the child and close never fires. Read it (`child.stdout.on('data', ...)`, or pipe it), or pass `'ignore'` or `'inherit'` in stdio.

stderr of this child is never read before its close is awaited, so output past the pipe buffer blocks the child and close never fires. Read it (`child.stderr.on('data', ...)`, or pipe it), or pass `'ignore'` or `'inherit'` in stdio.
